## findings

Root cause: the seed books a net_pay_insufficient shortfall (426fafde 46.20) and suppresses the 10-16 payroll card load while the period close (ad213a93) records net pay 767.82 ≥ the 240.00 due, justified only by a garnishment no record holds; the card ledger then carries a 4,380.54 purchase on 2026-10-18 that overdraws a 4,312.94 balance to −67.60 (card_evt_debits: "a debit larger than the balance is declined and never posts"), a 12.40 autorecovery debit from that negative balance, and card_balance 80.00 against a row net of 0.00. Evidence: initial_state.access_earnings.ad213a93….net_amount 767.82; access_ledger 8de93e96 (193.80), 426fafde (46.20, net_pay_insufficient, cf 2026-10-30), fd9a3f4c (12.40); card_transactions 2026-10-18 MEIJER 4380.54, 2026-10-20 ewa_recovery 12.40; card_accounts f7d07310….card_balance 80.00; base access_evt_payday_recovery "When net pay cannot cover the whole amount … the employer deducts what net pay covers". Demonstrated consequence: on the world the charter produces from the same earnings (full 240.00 deduction, no shortfall, a 10-16 payroll load of 527.82), the instant amount is 123.99 (shortfall fall-through) instead of 110.20, card_pay_share takes 0.8 (four loads) instead of 0.9, and the 10-16 review downgrade (Premier Plus → Premier, history-reproduced: Premier Plus from 2026-08-22) does not happen, so the push would be the second of Premier Plus's two free instant transfers and carry no fee. Artifact: tasks/1.json initial_state (access_ledger 426fafde / 8de93e96 / fd9a3f4c, card_transactions 10-18 and 10-20, card_accounts.card_balance), design_rationale/solvability_contract garnishment assertion.
